content.comment_body: Hello, how can I modify a ladder diagram in a binary .bin file? I am using [product_name] ([version_no]) demo.
If it's possible in the demo version, try File > Save As and choose ".bin" as the file format. I'm not completely certain since I don't have the demo available.
I believe this issue isn't specific to whether it's the demo or full version.
This feature is available in the full version.

You are correct, but my question is a bit different. For instance, if I have a binary file with switch settings and I change a switch to a momentary pushbutton, that change isn't saved in the binary file. The program asks me to resave it as a [product_name] project file instead.

Simulation input settings are only stored in the original project file, not in a BIN file. These settings remain valid for simulation but are not saved in the device's binary file. If you download a program from the controller back to the PC, those simulation settings are no longer available.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to edit ladder diagrams within .bin files using [product_name] ([version_no]) demo version. There is uncertainty regarding file formats and what changes can be saved. Device type settings (such as changing switches to momentary pushbuttons) are not stored in .bin files, which are meant for device programming rather than simulation or project editing. This results in users losing certain configurations and needing to use another file format to retain those changes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to have the ability to modify ladder diagrams and simulation input device settings within .bin files and have these changes remain after saving the file.
